text:
Evan W: seeing autoscaler thrash in us-west-2 during the sudden traffic spike — scale-up -> immediate scale-down -> pods Pending due to GPU quota. errors spike on /v1/generate : 503s and OOMs.
Priya N: can you paste the autoscaler logs? is this the new probe change we rolled yesterday?
Evan W: attaching quick snippet from autoscaler: 
```
2026-03-18T14:12:01Z scale-event: attempt=1 target=40 current=10 reason=cpu
2026-03-18T14:12:04Z provision: requested 30 gpus -> provider-queue delayed
2026-03-18T14:12:07Z scale-event: attempt=1 -> reverted target=12 (quota_error)
2026-03-18T14:12:09Z scale-event: attempt=2 target=36 reason=request_burst
2026-03-18T14:12:11Z scale-event: attempt=2 -> scaledown target=14 (policy-cooldown)
```
Evan W: looks like provider returned quota error intermittently, then our cooldown logic shrank again.
Lina K: @Priya might be the probe deltas toggling the scale signal — we saw similar where fast-moving request-per-second metric flipped fast.
Marco G: I'm seeing nodes Pending in GCLOUD with error "quotaExceeded" for nvidia-t4. There was a backend batch provisioning delay.
sre-oncall: infra-bot reports region us-west-2 reported partial control-plane latency ~2000ms around 14:11 UTC. Failover did not trigger because routing policy still pinned some traffic to us-west-2.
Priya N: immediate actions: 1) pause autoscaler in us-west-2 -> set desired to current+8 to give headroom 2) shift 30% traffic to us-east-1 using router weights 3) open ticket with cloud to confirm GPU bucket health.
Evan W: running command to pause: `kubectl annotate hpa --all autoscaling.kubernetes.io/paused=true -n inference` (will patch specific pools in 2min).
Marco G: manual node request to provider sent (req-28933). cloud console shows "allocating" for 340 minutes... weird. I also increased pool quota for the account in the portal but the API still returning 429s.
Lina K: can we relax our cooldown to avoid oscillations? current window is 30s which is too short for provider latency. Suggest bump to 5m during noisy windows.
Priya N: agreed. Also add a short-lived static pool: create nodepool gpu-hot-ephemeral size=8 in us-east-1 and pin critical routes. I'll handle router change.
Evan W: router weight change done -> us-east-1 +30%, us-west-2 -30%. Monitoring: token latency down from 1100ms -> 320ms in 90s. error-rate falling.
infra-bot: [AUTO] Deploybot: scaled nodepool gpu-hot-ephemeral -> 8 nodes in us-east-1 (task id deploy-789)
Marco G: after pause and pin, autoscaler logs stopped oscillating. we still have ~20 pods Pending due to image pull timeout on the newly provisioned nodes (registry rate-limit).
Priya N: on that — switch imagePullPolicy to IfNotPresent on rollout and add an extra registry mirror in us-east-1. Lina can you quick patch?
Lina K: doing a hotfix PR now, will patch daemonset for mirrors.
Evan W: postmortem checklist: 1) tighten probe smoothing to avoid short spikes 2) increase provider quota pre-warm scripts for scheduled big events 3) add circuit to prevent scale-down for 10m after quota errors 4) route fallback to next healthy region automatically.
Priya N: I'll write the incident ticket and assign follow-ups. tagging @sre-oncall for post-incident review. :white_check_mark:
Marco G: notes for runbook update: include cloud quota transient handling, and add a step to create ephemeral pool in a healthy region.
sre-oncall: thanks team. keeping this open for 2h to validate recovery, then we'll close and move to postmortem channel. :thumbsup:
Evan W: thanks all — keeping watch.
